arguments.text: Fixed. In `src/click/core.py`, `Option.__init__` unconditionally set `self.default = False` for flags when no default was given, which made a `required=True` flag look like it had a value and skip the "Missing option" check. It now only forces that default when the flag is not required (`if is_flag and default_is_missing and not self.required`). A required flag given no argument now exits with code 2 and "Error: Missing option '--flag'." while `--flag` still works. Full test suite still passes (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

import os, pathlib, click

def test_symlink_resolution(tmp_path):
    test_file = tmp_path / "file.txt"
    test_file.write_text("test")
    link = tmp_path / "link.txt"
    link.symlink_to(test_file)

    param = click.Path(resolve_path=True)
    ctx = click.Context(click.Command("test"))
    assert param.convert(str(link), None, ctx) == str(test_file.resolve())

def test_symlink_relative(tmp_path):
    test_file = tmp_path / "file.txt"
    test_file.write_text("test")
    link = tmp_path / "link.txt"
    link.symlink_to("file.txt")
    param = click.Path(resolve_path=True)
    ctx = click.Context(click.Command("test"))
    assert param.convert(str(link), None, ctx) == str(test_file.resolve())
EOF
